summary: Iteration 4 - Comprehensive testing of NEW features: PDF export, research templates (6), source credibility scoring, and Fast Mode. All 13 backend pytest tests PASSED (100%). Frontend testing via Playwright confirms 6 template cards render, template click populates topic input, Fast Mode toggle switches state, credibility badges display with color coding on History page, session details show sources with credibility scores, and Export dropdown is present. Fast-mode research completed in ~15 seconds with 3 high-credibility sources (80/100 avg).

minor.issue: FastAPI on_event is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handler (non-blocking)

issues: Footer still says 'Powered by CrewAI + GPT-5.2 Thinking' even though Fast Mode uses gpt-4o-mini by default. Consider dynamic text or update copy.

action_items: Optional: migrate FastAPI shutdown handler from on_event to lifespan
Optional: update footer copy to reflect that Fast Mode uses GPT-4o Mini
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~950 lines and includes routes, models, templates, credibility logic, PDF/MD generators, and CrewAI orchestration. Split into modules (routes/, services/, models.py, credibility.py, pdf_generator.py) for maintainability.
connectToStream in App.js has stale-closure risk: isResearching captured in useCallback deps causes reconnect callback to use stale value; ref-based flag would be more robust.
extract_and_score_sources caps at 10 sources but URL regex may capture markdown-link URL punctuation (parens etc.). Current rstrip handles common cases, adequate.

score_source_credibility TLD check uses url_lower.endswith(tld) which won't match URLs with paths (e.g. .edu/path); the OR check `f'{tld}/' in url_lower` compensates but is fragile. Consider using urlparse to extract hostname/TLD reliably.
PDF generation catches broad Exception and swallows; could log the specific paragraph that failed for debugging.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 fast-mode session: 'TEST_ Benefits of solar energy' (completed successfully, credibility 80/100, 3 sources)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features working: (1) GET /api/templates returns 6 templates with expected IDs; (2) fast_mode=true uses gpt-4o-mini and completes in ~15s; (3) sources extracted from researcher_output with credibility_score/level/reasons; overall credibility_score computed as avg; (4) PDF/MD/JSON exports all return correct content-types. Frontend renders TemplatesGrid, Fast Mode Switch, CredibilityBadge with proper color-coded classes, ExportMenu with PDF/MD/JSON options.
